findings.title: tslint.json superseded by eslintrc but left in repo
findings.note: tslint.json remains alongside .eslintrc.json but tslint is not a devDependency and no script references it, so the old config is inert; only the eslint side has tooling behind it. No removal date or ticket found for the tslint file.

findings.title: legacyFormat kept as a wrapper around formatMoney, still called
findings.note: legacyFormat is annotated @deprecated in favor of formatMoney, but it is the only formatter called in checkout.ts (1 of 1 call site in src still on the old side); no other module calls formatMoney directly. No removal date is stated.

findings.title: newCheckout feature flag path never completed, dead new branch

evidence.quote:
// newCheckout has been off since launch; the new flow was never finished
  newCheckout: false,

findings.note: checkout.ts branches on the newCheckout flag, but the flag is permanently false and the comment states the new flow was never finished; 100% of call sites run the old/legacy branch and the new branch is unreachable dead code with no plan or date to finish or remove it.

open_questions.question: Is there a ticket tracking removal of tslint.json, or was it left behind unintentionally after the eslint migration?
Is there an owner or ticket for finishing or removing the newCheckout flow, given the comment says it was never finished?

looks_bad_but_fine.why: client.ts and client-admin.ts are coupled and similar but appear to be a deliberate split between public and admin API clients (different base URLs, tokens, timeout handling) rather than an old/new duplication; no naming or comment hints suggest one supersedes the other.

not_assessed: Whether tslint is deprecated as a library/tool (not verified via package registry)
Any CVE or vulnerability status of eslint/tslint/jest versions
Test coverage percentage actually achieved vs. the 80% jest threshold in package.json
